paper_metadata.title: STRUCTURE AND MECHANICAL PROPERTIES OF Ti-Cr-Al-Nb AND Ti-Cr-Al-Nb-V MULTICOMPONENT ALLOYS
paper_metadata.journal: Problems of Atomic Science and Technology

evidence.quote: five- and four-component alloys of the Ti-Cr-Al-Nb-V system
Two compositions of lightweight alloys were selected for experimental study: Ti60Cr11Al7Nb11V11 and Ti60Cr11Al7Nb22 (at. %).

Nanohardness of the Ti60Cr11Al7Nb11V11 alloy after annealing at 900 ºC for 15 min (samples #1.2 and 2.2 in Table 4) is also higher than that of the Ti60Cr11Al7Nb22 alloy ((4.7 ± 0.07) GPa for sample #1.2 and (4.5 ± 0.18) GPa for sample #2.2).
the Young's modulus of the five-component alloy is also higher than that of the four-component alloy and is (125.6 ± 3) GPa for sample #1.2
the yield strength and tensile strength of the five-component alloy are noticeably higher than those of the four-component alloy.
